objective: Probe whether GPT-6 Luna none has usable additional capacity alongside the ongoing Astra low benchmark
scope: One Luna compatibility request, then up to three cycles of Astra before, three concurrent bounded Luna requests, Astra after. At most 16 total API requests; no retries; stop the load sequence after a 429 or fatal configuration response.
interpretation_limits: Background Astra traffic prevents clean attribution of counter changes.
A successful short probe does not establish sustained combined throughput or prove independent model limit groups.

result.interpretation: Different model-reported limits contradict a simple universal 1M TPM ceiling. Luna 429s reported 2M used despite only about 60k successful input tokens in this probe; attribution is unresolved. Probe does not establish independent quotas or sustained aggregate capacity.
